note: Campground at Hungry Jack Lodge on Hungry Jack Lake, off the Gunflint Trail about 26 miles up from Grand Marais and a base camp for the BWCA: secluded wooded sites behind the lodge, with spaces for large motorhomes. Campers may use the lodge's swimming beach, sauna and playground, rent boats and canoes, and eat in its dining room. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: $40/night for 2 (+$8 per extra person or pet, tax extra, prepaid non-refundable), water + 30 A, showers/flush/dump, phone reservations only; season Memorial Day to mid-October. Price gate passes; Google 4.7/376; nightly campground, no long-stay issue. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Price gate: passes ($40 a night for 2 on the operator's own page; no gateway within 40 km, not needed).
Google: 4.7 stars, 376 reviews (the lodge listing; passes). RV Life 5 stars, tier 2 stored.

Long-stay: none. Nightly campground sold by phone ('Please call to make your camping reservation today! Online reservations are not available for the campground at this time.'); no seasonal or monthly sites offered. Web presence: own site with posted price and phone.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. Imagery shows the RV sites in woods north of the lodge building (around 48.0600,-90.4525); the shore is lined by the lodge's cabins and docks, and the nearest open water from the campsite clearings is ~40-130 m through continuous trees and cabin lots. 'Secluded and wooded' per the operator.
Pin 48.06025,-90.45261 is in the campground clearing ~175 m north of Google's lodge point 48.058693,-90.453057; fine. Phone 218-388-2265 and website confirmed.
